configurations.title: Plasma table: dual-Y gantry, torch height Z, divided-voltage THC module on FREQ0, torch start, Arc OK, float switch, breakaway; ohmic sensing only with a qualified external ohmic module (not specified in IS-1)
configurations.hardware: Standard 8-motor controller + plasma.divided_voltage.v1 module (separately rated, own identity) on XF
configurations.interpretation: Arc voltage enters only through the isolated plasma.divided_voltage.v1 module into FREQ0; raw arc voltage never reaches any controller terminal. Arc OK and torch start are wired direct (DI7, XPC0) only when the source's CNC port provides a dry Arc OK contact and a torch-start input within the XPC contact rating (0-30 V, <= 50 mA); otherwise both pass through the module. This supersedes PLASMA_MODULE_SYSTEM section 2's 'module provides Arc OK and torch start' for sources that meet those conditions; the module still carries the divided voltage. Float switch uses PRB0 (hardware capture during probe-down); PRB1 takes the contact output of an external ohmic module, which is not specified in IS-1; ohmic enable uses process enable 1. HF-start sources with ohmic sensing are rejected by profile.
configurations.linuxcnc_mapping: trivkins coordinates=XYYZ; [KINS]JOINTS=4; plasmac component: arc-voltage-in from cnc1.freq.0 via the module calibration chain; arc-ok-in from DI7; float-switch from PRB0, ohmic-probe from PRB1; torch-on -> cnc1.proc-en.0

configurations.title: Twelve-motor multi-head gantry machine, every motor with encoder feedback (MX4 + EX8 fitted together)
configurations.hardware: Twelve-motor controller: MX4 motor expansion + EX8 encoder expansion + XTB terminal board, all factory-fitted
configurations.interpretation: Joint map follows the sim-12motor profile (XYYZABCUVWZZ): gantry Y1/Y2, three ganged plunging heads (Z, Z2, Z3 share the Z coordinate and move together), A/C head, B rotary table, U/V/W offset slides. All twelve drives return ABZ to ENC0-ENC11. The three spindles take speed and direction over Modbus RS-485 and each has a hardware run-enable on DO12-DO14, so a bus failure, host crash or permission loss stops them.

hal_map_note: Every assignment carries a 'hal' block: motors give joint, axis letter, extra-joint flag and the single motor-pos-fb source; DI, encoders, probes and frequency inputs list the pins they write; DO, AO and process enables name their single writer. tools/interface_spec_validate.py builds the net list from these blocks and refuses two writers on one pin, a joint without exactly one feedback source, gantry members with different HOME_SEQUENCE values, an unhome index beyond the joint count, a bus-only spindle run path, a mislabelled pendant selector and a DO peak above the 0.62 A current-limit minimum without a relay.
